jp: ビッグモスキートの頭や足が変異した特殊個体。人家を訪問し、うっかり招き入れてしまうと大繁殖してアグレッシブに住人を襲う。家に帰れなくなり街にたむろし続ける市民が誕生する原因でもある。招かれないと家に入れないのが弱点。
jp_grezzo: "ビッグモスキートの頭や足が変異した特殊個体。人家を訪問し、うっかり招き入れてしまうと大繁殖してアグレッシブに住人を襲う。家に帰れなくなり街にたむろし続ける市民が誕生する原因でもある。招かれないと家に入れないのが弱点。"
en: Big Mosquito Mutant: A special variant with enlarged head and limbs. If accidentally invited into homes, they breed rapidly and aggressively attack inhabitants. These incidents cause citizens to be unable to return home, congregating in the streets.
en_grezzo: "Big Mosquito Mutant: A special variant with enlarged head and limbs. If accidentally invited into homes, they breed rapidly and aggressively attack inhabitants. These incidents cause citizens to be unable to return home, congregating in the streets."
it: Esemplare speciale della zanzara gigante, con testa e zampe mutate. Visita le case, e se per distrazione la si invita a entrare si moltiplica senza freni e aggredisce gli abitanti. È anche la ragione per cui certi cittadini non tornano più a casa e restano a bighellonare per le strade. Il punto debole: senza invito, in casa non entra.

jp: 現代イルヴァにおける人間ぶっ殺しナンバーワン生物。目立たないだけで死因の7～8割が蚊。ほぼビッグモスキートに自宅で襲われて死ぬ。インド象とかマンモスとか関係なく鉄拳で叩きのめし、性別とか産卵時期とか関係なく吸血する。
jp_grezzo: "現代イルヴァにおける人間ぶっ殺しナンバーワン生物。目立たないだけで死因の7～8割が蚊。ほぼビッグモスキートに自宅で襲われて死ぬ。インド象とかマンモスとか関係なく鉄拳で叩きのめし、性別とか産卵時期とか関係なく吸血する。"
en: Mosquito: The number one human killer in modern Irva. Most deaths occur at home, crushed by these unassuming insects. Even an Indian Elephant or mammoth is no match, as mosquitoes don't discriminate by gender or breeding season.
en_grezzo: "Mosquito: The number one human killer in modern Irva. Most deaths occur at home, crushed by these unassuming insects. Even an Indian Elephant or mammoth is no match, as mosquitoes don't discriminate by gender or breeding season."
it: Il primo ammazzauomini dell'Irva di oggi. Non dà nell'occhio, ma il settanta-ottanta per cento delle morti porta la sua firma: quasi tutti muoiono in casa propria, sotto la zanzara gigante. Elefante indiano o mammut per lei è lo stesso, li stende a pugni; e succhia il sangue senza badare al sesso né alla stagione della deposizione.

jp: ポート・カプールへの処女航海中にエーテル風で沈没したはずの帆船。一度は船体が引き裂かれて海の藻屑と化したがその時不思議なことが起こり、なんか人型になって目的の港へたどり着いた。女王様気どりだが元が商船なのでカネにうるさく、戦闘力も低い。
jp_grezzo: "ポート・カプールへの処女航海中にエーテル風で沈没したはずの帆船。一度は船体が引き裂かれて海の藻屑と化したがその時不思議なことが起こり、なんか人型になって目的の港へたどり着いた。女王様気どりだが元が商船なのでカネにうるさく、戦闘力も低い。"
en: Queen Sedona: A sailing ship that sank during its maiden voyage to Port Kapul due to an Etherwind. Though its hull was torn apart, it inexplicably transformed into a humanoid form and reached its destination. It acts haughty like a queen, but being originally a merchant vessel, it's quite money-oriented and lacks combat strength.
en_grezzo: "Queen Sedona: A sailing ship that sank during its maiden voyage to Port Kapul due to an Etherwind. Though its hull was torn apart, it inexplicably transformed into a humanoid form and reached its destination. It acts haughty like a queen, but being originally a merchant vessel, it's quite money-oriented and lacks combat strength."
it: Un veliero che sarebbe dovuto affondare per il vento d'etere durante il viaggio inaugurale verso Porto Kapul. Lo scafo si squarciò e finì in pasto al mare, ma in quel momento accadde qualcosa di strano: prese una forma umana e arrivò lo stesso al porto di destinazione. Si dà arie da regina, ma era una nave mercantile: tiene ai soldi e in battaglia vale poco.

jp: イェルス軍の公式広報キャラクター。余った広報予算を使い切るため開発主任にPR用の実機を作らせたところ、決戦兵器の規格落ち部品や不採用部品を流用。宣伝目的なのにやたら強力な機体へと仕上がった。
jp_grezzo: "イェルス軍の公式広報キャラクター。余った広報予算を使い切るため開発主任にPR用の実機を作らせたところ、決戦兵器の規格落ち部品や不採用部品を流用。宣伝目的なのにやたら強力な機体へと仕上がった。"
en: The official PR character of the Yerles Army. Created to spend leftover promotion funds, it was made using surplus and rejected parts, resulting in an overly powerful machine for just PR purposes.
en_grezzo: "The official PR character of the Yerles Army. Created to spend leftover promotion funds, it was made using surplus and rejected parts, resulting in an overly powerful machine for just PR purposes."
it: La mascotte ufficiale dell'esercito di Yerles. Per esaurire il budget pubblicitario avanzato fecero costruire al capo progettista un esemplare vero da esposizione, e quello riciclò gli scarti di lavorazione e i pezzi bocciati delle armi decisive. Ne è uscita una macchina assurdamente potente, e solo per farsi pubblicità.

jp: トロッコ事故の危険性を啓発するためのキャラクター。もしも行く手に５人の作業員、分かれ道に１人の作業員がいた場合、レールから外れて全員轢きに行くタイプの問題児。積んでいるのは犠牲者の血で染めた鉱石だ。
jp_grezzo: "トロッコ事故の危険性を啓発するためのキャラクター。もしも行く手に５人の作業員、分かれ道に１人の作業員がいた場合、レールから外れて全員轢きに行くタイプの問題児。積んでいるのは犠牲者の血で染めた鉱石だ。"
en: Character designated to educate about the dangers of minecart accidents. If encountered with 5 workers ahead and 1 at a fork, it will do a multi-track drift to run all of them down.
en_grezzo: "Character designated to educate about the dangers of minecart accidents. If encountered with 5 workers ahead and 1 at a fork, it will do a multi-track drift to run all of them down."
it: Un personaggio nato per sensibilizzare sui pericoli degli incidenti in miniera. Se davanti ha cinque operai e sul binario di scarto uno solo, è il tipo che esce dalle rotaie e va ad arrotarli tutti quanti. Il carico è minerale tinto del sangue delle vittime.

jp: ハクビシン。その名の通り、鼻筋の白いラインが特徴。雷神の欠片を宿しており、雷に乗って高速移動することから雷獣の異名を持つ。狸に間違われることも多いが、どちらかというと猫の親戚であり木登りが得意。
jp_grezzo: "ハクビシン。その名の通り、鼻筋の白いラインが特徴。雷神の欠片を宿しており、雷に乗って高速移動することから雷獣の異名を持つ。狸に間違われることも多いが、どちらかというと猫の親戚であり木登りが得意。"
en: Also known as the Hakubishin. As its name suggests, it is characterized by a white stripe on its nose. Said to harbor a shard of the Lightning God within, enabling it to move at high speeds by riding lightning currents, earning it the moniker of the 'Thunder Beast'. While often mistaken for a raccoon, it is more closely related to cats and is adept at climbing trees.
en_grezzo: "Also known as the Hakubishin. As its name suggests, it is characterized by a white stripe on its nose. Said to harbor a shard of the Lightning God within, enabling it to move at high speeds by riding lightning currents, earning it the moniker of the 'Thunder Beast'. While often mistaken for a raccoon, it is more closely related to cats and is adept at climbing trees."
it: Lo zibetto delle palme mascherato. Come dice il nome, lo si riconosce dalla riga bianca sul dorso del naso. Porta in sé una scheggia del dio del fulmine e cavalca la folgore per spostarsi velocissimo: per questo lo chiamano anche la bestia del tuono. Lo scambiano spesso per un cane procione, ma è piuttosto parente del gatto ed è bravissimo ad arrampicarsi sugli alberi.

jp: 別名ムジナ。味方を囲んで防御力の高い密集陣形を作る。狸とは親戚ではないのだが見た目が似ており、穴熊が掘った巣穴に狸が勝手に住み着くことがあるので本当に紛らわしい。同じ穴のムジナと言われて混同されがち。
jp_grezzo: "別名ムジナ。味方を囲んで防御力の高い密集陣形を作る。狸とは親戚ではないのだが見た目が似ており、穴熊が掘った巣穴に狸が勝手に住み着くことがあるので本当に紛らわしい。同じ穴のムジナと言われて混同されがち。"
en: Also known as the Badger (Mujina). It forms a dense, defensive formation by surrounding allies. Despite their similar appearance, they are not related to raccoons. Sometimes, they occupy holes dug by raccoons, causing confusion within them.
en_grezzo: "Also known as the Badger (Mujina). It forms a dense, defensive formation by surrounding allies. Despite their similar appearance, they are not related to raccoons. Sometimes, they occupy holes dug by raccoons, causing confusion within them."
it: Detto anche mujina. Circonda i compagni e forma uno schieramento serrato dall'ottima difesa. Non è parente del cane procione, ma gli somiglia, e capita che il cane procione si installi senza permesso nella tana che il tasso ha scavato: una confusione continua. Il modo di dire su quei due che stanno nella stessa buca non aiuta.

jp: 馬の隣に並べてはいけない生物。食欲がすごく、こいつが山に数匹いるだけでマジで山がハゲ山に変わるほど。寄生虫が身体にめちゃくちゃついており、植物を食い漁った地域に寄生虫を残していく。
jp_grezzo: "馬の隣に並べてはいけない生物。食欲がすごく、こいつが山に数匹いるだけでマジで山がハゲ山に変わるほど。寄生虫が身体にめちゃくちゃついており、植物を食い漁った地域に寄生虫を残していく。"
en: A creature that should never be placed next to a horse. It has an enormous appetite - having just a few of these in a mountain can strip it bare, turning it into a barren, bald mountain. It is covered in parasites and leaves a trail of these parasites in the areas it has ravaged by feeding on plants.
en_grezzo: "A creature that should never be placed next to a horse. It has an enormous appetite - having just a few of these in a mountain can strip it bare, turning it into a barren, bald mountain. It is covered in parasites and leaves a trail of these parasites in the areas it has ravaged by feeding on plants."
it: Una creatura che non va messa accanto a un cavallo. Ha una fame smisurata: bastano pochi esemplari su un monte perché il monte diventi davvero pelato. È coperto di parassiti fino all'inverosimile, e li lascia dietro di sé in ogni zona che ha spogliato delle piante.

jp: 大型のダニ。普段はマジカにくっついて最低限の血と魔力を吸って暮らしている。宿主が死亡したことに気づくと、吸えるだけ吸ってパンパンに膨れた状態で離れていく。下手につつくと破裂するぞ。
jp_grezzo: "大型のダニ。普段はマジカにくっついて最低限の血と魔力を吸って暮らしている。宿主が死亡したことに気づくと、吸えるだけ吸ってパンパンに膨れた状態で離れていく。下手につつくと破裂するぞ。"
en: Ginat ticks that usually lives attached to a Magic. It subsists by drawing a minimal amount of blood and magical power from its host. When the host dies, it drinks as much as it can and detaches in a bloated state. Be careful not to poke it, as it may burst.
en_grezzo: "Ginat ticks that usually lives attached to a Magic. It subsists by drawing a minimal amount of blood and magical power from its host. When the host dies, it drinks as much as it can and detaches in a bloated state. Be careful not to poke it, as it may burst."
it: Una zecca di taglia grossa. Di solito vive attaccata al magicervo e ne succhia il minimo indispensabile di sangue e di potere magico. Quando si accorge che l'ospite è morto, succhia tutto quello che può e si stacca gonfia da scoppiare. E attenzione a stuzzicarla male, perché scoppia davvero.

jp: 畑を荒らす害獣。見た目が可愛いからといって飼育する無知な人間も多いが、気性が荒いので飼うのがだんだんツラくなってくるのだ。これは本来住んでいなかった地域にわざと捨てられることで、生息範囲を拡大していくという戦略なのだ。見た目が似ているのでタヌキに畑荒らしの罪をなすりつけることが多いのだ。
jp_grezzo: "畑を荒らす害獣。見た目が可愛いからといって飼育する無知な人間も多いが、気性が荒いので飼うのがだんだんツラくなってくるのだ。これは本来住んでいなかった地域にわざと捨てられることで、生息範囲を拡大していくという戦略なのだ。見た目が似ているのでタヌキに畑荒らしの罪をなすりつけることが多いのだ。"
en: Crop destroying pests. Many people naively try to keep it as a pet because of its cute appearance, but its wild temperament eventually makes it unbearable to keep. This is part of its strategy to expand its habitat - careless owners intentionally release them in new areas. It often gets blamed for the crop destruction and has the raccoon dog (tanuki) taking the fall because of their similar appearance.
en_grezzo: "Crop destroying pests. Many people naively try to keep it as a pet because of its cute appearance, but its wild temperament eventually makes it unbearable to keep. This is part of its strategy to expand its habitat - careless owners intentionally release them in new areas. It often gets blamed for the crop destruction and has the raccoon dog (tanuki) taking the fall because of their similar appearance."
it: Un animale nocivo che devasta i campi. Molti ignoranti lo prendono in casa perché ha l'aria carina, ma ha un pessimo carattere e tenerlo diventa via via più duro. E questa è la sua strategia: farsi abbandonare apposta dove non viveva, e allargare così il proprio territorio. Somigliandogli, il cane procione si prende spesso la colpa delle sue razzie.

jp: 拉致や身売りによって悪の手先に堕ちた軽トラック。収穫前のやや未熟な作物を根こそぎ盗んでいき、カスみてぇな値段で路上販売する。捕まえてもわざと軽トラ語しか喋らないので何を言っているのか分からず最悪。
jp_grezzo: "拉致や身売りによって悪の手先に堕ちた軽トラック。収穫前のやや未熟な作物を根こそぎ盗んでいき、カスみてぇな値段で路上販売する。捕まえてもわざと軽トラ語しか喋らないので何を言っているのか分からず最悪。"
en: A light truck that has derailed into evil paths due to abduction and trafficking. It steals and unroots entire crops before they're fully ripe, then sells them for a paltry sum on the streets. Even if caught, it deliberately only speaks in truck language, making it impossible to understand what it's saying, which is utterly frustrating.
en_grezzo: "A light truck that has derailed into evil paths due to abduction and trafficking. It steals and unroots entire crops before they're fully ripe, then sells them for a paltry sum on the streets. Even if caught, it deliberately only speaks in truck language, making it impossible to understand what it's saying, which is utterly frustrating."
it: Un furgoncino finito al servizio del male fra rapimenti e compravendite. Ruba fino all'ultima radice i raccolti ancora acerbi e li rivende per strada a prezzi da fame. Anche quando lo si prende parla apposta soltanto la lingua dei furgoncini, e non si capisce niente di quello che dice: il peggio.

jp: 臓物を食べてその味のトリコになってしまい、もう元の食生活には戻れなくなった。獲物がまだ死んでいなくても我慢できずに腹を裂いて食い漁る。同じ熊の他モンスターと比較してもフィジカルが段違いであり、非常に危険。
jp_grezzo: "臓物を食べてその味のトリコになってしまい、もう元の食生活には戻れなくなった。獲物がまだ死んでいなくても我慢できずに腹を裂いて食い漁る。同じ熊の他モンスターと比較してもフィジカルが段違いであり、非常に危険。"
en: Motuhegui (Organ-Mauler), having become addicted to the taste of organs, they can no longer revert to their previous diet. Even if prey is still alive, they cannot resist the urge to tear open its belly and feed. Compared to other bears and monsters, their physical prowess is in a completely different league, making them extremely dangerous.
en_grezzo: "Motuhegui (Organ-Mauler), having become addicted to the taste of organs, they can no longer revert to their previous diet. Even if prey is still alive, they cannot resist the urge to tear open its belly and feed. Compared to other bears and monsters, their physical prowess is in a completely different league, making them extremely dangerous."
it: Ha assaggiato le interiora, ne è rimasto schiavo e non è più tornato alla dieta di prima. Non aspetta nemmeno che la preda sia morta: le apre il ventre e divora. Anche fra gli altri mostri della famiglia degli orsi la sua stazza è di un altro ordine, ed è pericolosissimo.

jp: モツヘグイの幼体だがこの時点でもかなりのパワーとタフネスを誇るモンスター。一般人が死に物狂いで顔面をぶん殴った程度ではびくともしないし、逆にひっかき一発で顔面を持っていかれる。お母さんといっしょに児童の臓物を引きずり出して美味しそうに食い漁る。
jp_grezzo: "モツヘグイの幼体だがこの時点でもかなりのパワーとタフネスを誇るモンスター。一般人が死に物狂いで顔面をぶん殴った程度ではびくともしないし、逆にひっかき一発で顔面を持っていかれる。お母さんといっしょに児童の臓物を引きずり出して美味しそうに食い漁る。"
en: A Motuhegui (Organ-Mauler) Cub, already boasting significant power and toughness. A person punching it with all their might would barely faze it, while a single scratch could easily take off their face. Together with its mother, it gleefully tears out and devours the organs of children.
en_grezzo: "A Motuhegui (Organ-Mauler) Cub, already boasting significant power and toughness. A person punching it with all their might would barely faze it, while a single scratch could easily take off their face. Together with its mother, it gleefully tears out and devours the organs of children."
it: È il cucciolo dello sbudellatore, e già così vanta una forza e una resistenza notevoli. Un uomo comune può tirargli in faccia un pugno con tutta la disperazione che ha, e quello non si sposta; una sua zampata, invece, la faccia la porta via. Insieme alla mamma tira fuori le interiora dei bambini e se le gusta.

jp: カードに宿る精霊。カードを通じて使い手とシンクロすることでパワーアップし、姿を変えていく。ラブリーな仕草で笑顔をふりまき人の心を惑わす魔女。仲間外のこのモンスターは通常の魔力制御判定とは別にランク×5％の確率で味方の巻き込みを無効にする。
jp_grezzo: "カードに宿る精霊。カードを通じて使い手とシンクロすることでパワーアップし、姿を変えていく。ラブリーな仕草で笑顔をふりまき人の心を惑わす魔女。仲間外のこのモンスターは通常の魔力制御判定とは別にランク×5％の確率で味方の巻き込みを無効にする。"
en: Spirits that inhabit the cards. By synchronising with the user through the card, it powers up and changes its appearance. A witch who bewitches people's hearts with her lovely gestures and smiles. Apart from the normal magic control judgement, this monster has a rank x 5% chance to not hit allies.
en_grezzo: "Spirits that inhabit the cards. By synchronising with the user through the card, it powers up and changes its appearance. A witch who bewitches people's hearts with her lovely gestures and smiles. Apart from the normal magic control judgement, this monster has a rank x 5% chance to not hit allies."
it: Uno spirito che abita nelle carte. Sincronizzandosi con chi la usa attraverso la carta cresce di potenza e cambia aspetto. È una strega che semina sorrisi con gesti graziosi e confonde il cuore della gente. Fuori squadra, questo mostro ha una probabilità di rango x 5% di non coinvolgere gli alleati, oltre alla normale prova di controllo del potere magico.

jp: カードに宿る精霊。カードを通じて使い手とシンクロすることでパワーアップし、姿を変えていく。身体についている真紅のダイヤは、眼としての機能も持つらしい。仲間外のこのモンスターが受けるダメージはランク×2％ダウンする。
jp_grezzo: "カードに宿る精霊。カードを通じて使い手とシンクロすることでパワーアップし、姿を変えていく。身体についている真紅のダイヤは、眼としての機能も持つらしい。仲間外のこのモンスターが受けるダメージはランク×2％ダウンする。"
en: Spirits that inhabit the cards. By synchronising with the user through the card, it powers up and changes its appearance. The crimson diamonds on its body are said to function as eyes. Damage taken by this monster is reduced by rank x 2%.
en_grezzo: "Spirits that inhabit the cards. By synchronising with the user through the card, it powers up and changes its appearance. The crimson diamonds on its body are said to function as eyes. Damage taken by this monster is reduced by rank x 2%."
it: Uno spirito che abita nelle carte. Sincronizzandosi con chi lo usa attraverso la carta cresce di potenza e cambia aspetto. Pare che i diamanti scarlatti che porta sul corpo gli facciano anche da occhi. Fuori squadra, questo mostro subisce rango x 2% di danno in meno.

jp: カードに宿る精霊。カードを通じて使い手とシンクロすることでパワーアップし、姿を変えていく。魔力を帯びた翼で凄まじい風を巻き起こし敵を攻撃する怪鳥。仲間外のこのモンスターの速度はランク×2％アップする。
jp_grezzo: "カードに宿る精霊。カードを通じて使い手とシンクロすることでパワーアップし、姿を変えていく。魔力を帯びた翼で凄まじい風を巻き起こし敵を攻撃する怪鳥。仲間外のこのモンスターの速度はランク×2％アップする。"
en: Spirits that inhabit the cards. By synchronising with the user through the card, it powers up and changes its appearance. Monstrous bird that attacks enemies by creating tremendous winds with its magical wings. The speed of this monster is increased by rank x 2%.
en_grezzo: "Spirits that inhabit the cards. By synchronising with the user through the card, it powers up and changes its appearance. Monstrous bird that attacks enemies by creating tremendous winds with its magical wings. The speed of this monster is increased by rank x 2%."
it: Uno spirito che abita nelle carte. Sincronizzandosi con chi la usa attraverso la carta cresce di potenza e cambia aspetto. È un uccellaccio che con le ali intrise di magia solleva venti tremendi e con quelli attacca. Fuori squadra, questo mostro guadagna rango x 2% di velocità.

jp: カードに宿る精霊。カードを通じて使い手とシンクロすることでパワーアップし、姿を変えていく。スペード状の剣を振るう鎧の戦士。スピードには特に興味がない。仲間外のこのモンスターが与えるダメージはランク×2％アップする。
jp_grezzo: "カードに宿る精霊。カードを通じて使い手とシンクロすることでパワーアップし、姿を変えていく。スペード状の剣を振るう鎧の戦士。スピードには特に興味がない。仲間外のこのモンスターが与えるダメージはランク×2％アップする。"
en: Spirits that inhabit the cards. By synchronising with the user through the card, it powers up and changes its appearance. Armoured warrior wielding a spade-shaped sword. Not particularly interested in speed. Damage inflicted by this monster is increased by rank x 2%.
en_grezzo: "Spirits that inhabit the cards. By synchronising with the user through the card, it powers up and changes its appearance. Armoured warrior wielding a spade-shaped sword. Not particularly interested in speed. Damage inflicted by this monster is increased by rank x 2%."
it: Uno spirito che abita nelle carte. Sincronizzandosi con chi lo usa attraverso la carta cresce di potenza e cambia aspetto. È un guerriero in armatura che brandisce una spada a forma di picca. La velocità non lo interessa granché. Fuori squadra, questo mostro infligge rango x 2% di danno in più.

jp: 巨大な青い狼の神様。骨をバリバリかみ砕いて骨髄をすするのが好き。神々の大戦時に結構な数の神をかみ殺した結果、危険視されて封印されてしまった。人狼たちはその封印を解くため、暗躍しているのだ。
jp_grezzo: "巨大な青い狼の神様。骨をバリバリかみ砕いて骨髄をすするのが好き。神々の大戦時に結構な数の神をかみ殺した結果、危険視されて封印されてしまった。人狼たちはその封印を解くため、暗躍しているのだ。"
en: Giant blue wolf god. Likes to crunch bones and sip marrow. As a result of chewing up quite a few gods during the War of the Gods, he was regarded as dangerous and sealed away. The werewolves are working in the dark to break the seal.
en_grezzo: "Giant blue wolf god. Likes to crunch bones and sip marrow. As a result of chewing up quite a few gods during the War of the Gods, he was regarded as dangerous and sealed away. The werewolves are working in the dark to break the seal."
it: Il dio lupo, azzurro e immenso. Gli piace stritolare le ossa a morsi e succhiarne il midollo. Nella grande guerra delle divinità ne sbranò un buon numero, e per questo lo giudicarono pericoloso e lo sigillarono. I licantropi tramano nell'ombra per spezzare quel sigillo.

jp: もふもふの九本の尻尾を持つ、妖狐の神様。それぞれの尻尾を別々に動かすのは難しいらしい。力を失って石になっていたが、人狼の儀式を乗っ取って復活できることが判明。子分の妖狐たちによって今日も人と狼を相手に騙しあいが行われている。
jp_grezzo: "もふもふの九本の尻尾を持つ、妖狐の神様。それぞれの尻尾を別々に動かすのは難しいらしい。力を失って石になっていたが、人狼の儀式を乗っ取って復活できることが判明。子分の妖狐たちによって今日も人と狼を相手に騙しあいが行われている。"
en: Fox god with nine fluffy tails. It is apparently difficult to move each tail separately. It lost its power and turned to stone, but was found to be able to revive itself by taking over the rituals of the werewolves. Today, the foxes, continue to deceive people and wolves alike.
en_grezzo: "Fox god with nine fluffy tails. It is apparently difficult to move each tail separately. It lost its power and turned to stone, but was found to be able to revive itself by taking over the rituals of the werewolves. Today, the foxes, continue to deceive people and wolves alike."
it: La divinità delle volpi magiche, con nove code morbidissime. Muoverle una per una, dicono, non è affatto semplice. Aveva perso il potere ed era diventata pietra, finché non si scoprì che poteva risorgere impadronendosi del rito dei licantropi. Anche oggi le volpi al suo servizio giocano d'inganno con uomini e lupi.

jp: 秘伝の技によって高位の精霊を宿らせた折り紙。式折神の上位存在。周囲の式折神を一瞬で取り込み、強大な力を発揮する。
jp_grezzo: "秘伝の技によって高位の精霊を宿らせた折り紙。式折神の上位存在。周囲の式折神を一瞬で取り込み、強大な力を発揮する。"
en: Origami in which a higher spirit is imbued by a hidden technique. A higher level being of the Shiki-Origami. It instantly absorbs in the surrounding Shiki-Origami and displays its mighty power.
en_grezzo: "Origami in which a higher spirit is imbued by a hidden technique. A higher level being of the Shiki-Origami. It instantly absorbs in the surrounding Shiki-Origami and displays its mighty power."
it: Un origami in cui una tecnica segreta ha fatto abitare uno spirito di rango alto. È la forma superiore delle divinità di carta piegata. Assorbe in un istante quelli che ha attorno e sprigiona una forza enorme.

jp: サイキョウという地方出身の妖怪ネズミ。特技は催眠や予言。頻繁に最強だと誤解されて面倒くさいトラブルに巻き込まれ、誤解を解いたら解いたでそのたびに勝手に失望されてきた。積年の屈辱から、実際に最強になってやろうと決意し努力を続けている。
jp_grezzo: "サイキョウという地方出身の妖怪ネズミ。特技は催眠や予言。頻繁に最強だと誤解されて面倒くさいトラブルに巻き込まれ、誤解を解いたら解いたでそのたびに勝手に失望されてきた。積年の屈辱から、実際に最強になってやろうと決意し努力を続けている。"
en: Yokai rats hail from a region called Saikyo. Its specialities are hypnosis and foretelling. They are frequently misunderstood due to Saikyo means the strongest and get into trouble, and each time they have been let down when their misunderstandings are cleared up. After years of humiliation, he has decided to actually become the strongest and is continuing his efforts.
en_grezzo: "Yokai rats hail from a region called Saikyo. Its specialities are hypnosis and foretelling. They are frequently misunderstood due to Saikyo means the strongest and get into trouble, and each time they have been let down when their misunderstandings are cleared up. After years of humiliation, he has decided to actually become the strongest and is continuing his efforts."
it: Un ratto stregato originario della regione di Saikyo. È bravo nell'ipnosi e nella profezia. Siccome Saikyo suona come il più forte, lo scambiano di continuo per tale e finisce in guai noiosissimi; e ogni volta che chiarisce l'equivoco qualcuno resta deluso, come se fosse colpa sua. Umiliato per anni, ha deciso di diventare davvero il più forte, e continua ad allenarsi.

jp: 生化学文明でも動物実験にはモルモットが使われていた。究極強化実験の素体にしたところ、想定以上のパワーアップを遂げて研究所を脱走した、という記録が残っている。どうやら野外で繁殖したらしく、現代でもその子孫がプイプイ言わせている。
jp_grezzo: "生化学文明でも動物実験にはモルモットが使われていた。究極強化実験の素体にしたところ、想定以上のパワーアップを遂げて研究所を脱走した、という記録が残っている。どうやら野外で繁殖したらしく、現代でもその子孫がプイプイ言わせている。"
en: In biochemical civilisation, guinea pigs were also used for animal experiments. There is a record of a guinea pig that escaped from a research institute after becoming more powerful than expected when used as an baseline specimen for ultimate enhancement experiments. Apparently, they were bred in the field, and their offspring are still making pui-pui sounds even today.
en_grezzo: "In biochemical civilisation, guinea pigs were also used for animal experiments. There is a record of a guinea pig that escaped from a research institute after becoming more powerful than expected when used as an baseline specimen for ultimate enhancement experiments. Apparently, they were bred in the field, and their offspring are still making pui-pui sounds even today."
it: Anche nella civiltà biochimica le cavie servivano per gli esperimenti sugli animali. Resta agli atti che una di esse, usata come base per l'esperimento di potenziamento supremo, crebbe di forza oltre ogni previsione e fuggì dal laboratorio. A quanto pare si è riprodotta all'aperto, e ancora oggi i suoi discendenti vanno in giro a fare pui pui.

jp: 脚が規格外の発達を遂げており、本気の蹴りは山が揺れるほどの衝撃。もしも鳴り動いた山からこのネズミが降りてきたら、拍子抜けしていないで深刻に考えたほうがよい。こいつの蹴りでも倒せないほどのバケモノにすみかを追われてきた可能性がある。
jp_grezzo: "脚が規格外の発達を遂げており、本気の蹴りは山が揺れるほどの衝撃。もしも鳴り動いた山からこのネズミが降りてきたら、拍子抜けしていないで深刻に考えたほうがよい。こいつの蹴りでも倒せないほどのバケモノにすみかを追われてきた可能性がある。"
en: Its legs are substandardly developed and its serious kicks have enough impact to shake a mountain. If this rat comes down from a moving mountain that rumbles, don't just take it easy, take it seriously. It may have been chased from its home by a monster that even its kicks cannot defeat.
en_grezzo: "Its legs are substandardly developed and its serious kicks have enough impact to shake a mountain. If this rat comes down from a moving mountain that rumbles, don't just take it easy, take it seriously. It may have been chased from its home by a monster that even its kicks cannot defeat."
it: Ha le zampe sviluppate fuori da ogni misura, e un suo calcio dato sul serio scuote la montagna. Se la montagna rimbomba e trema e poi ne esce questo topo, invece di restare delusi conviene prenderla sul serio: può darsi che dalla tana lo abbia cacciato un mostro che nemmeno i suoi calci abbattono.

jp: エウダーナでポーション開発に用いられていた実験動物。度重なる実験の中で変異し、投与された薬物を貯蔵・合成する臓器…通称、ポーションぶくろが形成されている。体内合成した麻痺薬をまき散らして研究員たちを無力化し、脱走した。
jp_grezzo: "エウダーナでポーション開発に用いられていた実験動物。度重なる実験の中で変異し、投与された薬物を貯蔵・合成する臓器…通称、ポーションぶくろが形成されている。体内合成した麻痺薬をまき散らして研究員たちを無力化し、脱走した。"
en: Experimental animals used for potion development in Eulderna. They mutated during repeated experiments and formed organs that store and synthesise the administered drugs... commonly known as a potion bag. They disperse the paralysing drugs synthesised in their bodies, incapacitating the researchers, and then escaped.
en_grezzo: "Experimental animals used for potion development in Eulderna. They mutated during repeated experiments and formed organs that store and synthesise the administered drugs... commonly known as a potion bag. They disperse the paralysing drugs synthesised in their bodies, incapacitating the researchers, and then escaped."
it: Un animale da laboratorio usato a Eulderna per mettere a punto le pozioni. A furia di esperimenti è mutata e le si è formato un organo che immagazzina e sintetizza i farmaci somministrati: la cosiddetta sacca delle pozioni. Ha sparso attorno il paralizzante prodotto dentro il proprio corpo, ha messo fuori gioco i ricercatori ed è fuggita.

jp: ネズミの中でも目と耳が特に良く、斥候として傭兵活動を行う。社交性も高く、よく仲間で集まって作戦会議をしている。
jp_grezzo: "ネズミの中でも目と耳が特に良く、斥候として傭兵活動を行う。社交性も高く、よく仲間で集まって作戦会議をしている。"
en: They have particularly good eyes and ears among rats, and perform mercenary work as scouts. They are also highly sociable and often get together with their friends for strategy meetings.
en_grezzo: "They have particularly good eyes and ears among rats, and perform mercenary work as scouts. They are also highly sociable and often get together with their friends for strategy meetings."
it: Fra i roditori è quello con la vista e l'udito migliori, e si vende come mercenario nel ruolo di esploratore. È anche molto socievole, e spesso si raduna con i compagni per fare consiglio di guerra.

jp: 人型の巨大ドブネズミ。中に人など入っていない。直接戦闘はあまり得意ではなく、獲物が他の生物と戦っているところを見計らって全力で接近して襲い掛かる。どうでもいいが、大型のネズミがラット、小型のネズミがマウスという区分である。
jp_grezzo: "人型の巨大ドブネズミ。中に人など入っていない。直接戦闘はあまり得意ではなく、獲物が他の生物と戦っているところを見計らって全力で接近して襲い掛かる。どうでもいいが、大型のネズミがラット、小型のネズミがマウスという区分である。"
en: Humanoid giant gerbils. There are no humans inside. They are not very good at direct combat, and will approach and attack at full speed when their prey is fighting other creatures. The large rats are classified as rats and the small ones as mice, although this is not important.
en_grezzo: "Humanoid giant gerbils. There are no humans inside. They are not very good at direct combat, and will approach and attack at full speed when their prey is fighting other creatures. The large rats are classified as rats and the small ones as mice, although this is not important."
it: Un enorme ratto di fogna dalla forma umana. Dentro non c'è nessuno. Nello scontro diretto non è granché: aspetta che la preda sia impegnata contro un'altra creatura, poi le piomba addosso a tutta velocità. Nota inutile: i roditori grossi si chiamano ratti, quelli piccoli topi.

jp: 長い後ろ足で立ちあがり、ぴょんぴょん飛び跳ねて移動するネズミ。本気を出すとかなりの高度まで垂直跳躍でき、身体の小ささもあるので見失うこと間違いなし。落下の勢いを乗せたカカト落としで敵の頭蓋骨を粉砕する。
jp_grezzo: "長い後ろ足で立ちあがり、ぴょんぴょん飛び跳ねて移動するネズミ。本気を出すとかなりの高度まで垂直跳躍でき、身体の小ささもあるので見失うこと間違いなし。落下の勢いを乗せたカカト落としで敵の頭蓋骨を粉砕する。"
en: Rats that stand up on their long hind legs and move around by hopping around. When it gets serious, it can leap vertically to a considerable altitude, and its small body is sure to lose sight of you. They crush the skulls of their enemies with a dropkick that carries the momentum of their fall.
en_grezzo: "Rats that stand up on their long hind legs and move around by hopping around. When it gets serious, it can leap vertically to a considerable altitude, and its small body is sure to lose sight of you. They crush the skulls of their enemies with a dropkick that carries the momentum of their fall."
it: Un topo che si rizza sulle lunghe zampe posteriori e si sposta a balzi. Quando fa sul serio salta in verticale a un'altezza notevole, e siccome è anche piccolo lo si perde di vista di sicuro. Con un calcio di tallone caricato dalla caduta sfonda il cranio del nemico.

jp: クソデカいネズミの一種。敵に襲われると臭い液体を噴射して抵抗する。身体が大きく運動能力も高いため、もしも飼うならクソデカい家具とクソデカい家が必要になる。
jp_grezzo: "クソデカいネズミの一種。敵に襲われると臭い液体を噴射して抵抗する。身体が大きく運動能力も高いため、もしも飼うならクソデカい家具とクソデカい家が必要になる。"
en: A type of rat that is damn large in size. When attacked by enemies, they resist by spraying smelly liquid. Because of their large size and athleticism, if you want to keep one, you will need damn big furnitures and a damn big house.
en_grezzo: "A type of rat that is damn large in size. When attacked by enemies, they resist by spraying smelly liquid. Because of their large size and athleticism, if you want to keep one, you will need damn big furnitures and a damn big house."
it: Una specie di roditore mastodontico. Se lo assalgono si difende spruzzando un liquido puzzolente. È grosso e pieno di energie, quindi per tenerlo in casa servono mobili mastodontici e una casa mastodontica.

jp: 低級の神や精霊を宿らせた折り紙。横風を受けようがまっすぐに飛んでいく。先端が刺さるとちょっと痛いなんてものではなく、魔力を集中させて爆発するのでとても危険。
jp_grezzo: "低級の神や精霊を宿らせた折り紙。横風を受けようがまっすぐに飛んでいく。先端が刺さるとちょっと痛いなんてものではなく、魔力を集中させて爆発するのでとても危険。"
en: Origami paper in which minor deities or spirits dwell. It flies straight ahead regardless of the crosswind. The tip is not only a little painful when it stings, but also very dangerous because it explodes when it concentrates magic power.
en_grezzo: "Origami paper in which minor deities or spirits dwell. It flies straight ahead regardless of the crosswind. The tip is not only a little painful when it stings, but also very dangerous because it explodes when it concentrates magic power."
it: Un origami in cui abita un dio o uno spirito di rango basso. Vola dritto anche con il vento di traverso. E quando la punta si conficca non fa un male sopportabile: concentra il potere magico ed esplode, il che lo rende pericolosissimo.

jp: 低級の神や精霊を宿らせた折り紙。端がノコギリのようにギザギザになっており、皮膚を切り裂き血を吸い上げる構造。高速で回転しながら飛んでいくので危険。
jp_grezzo: "低級の神や精霊を宿らせた折り紙。端がノコギリのようにギザギザになっており、皮膚を切り裂き血を吸い上げる構造。高速で回転しながら飛んでいくので危険。"
en: Origami paper in which minor deities or spirits dwell. It has jagged edges like a hacksaw, and is designed to cut through the skin and suck up blood. It flies while spinning at high speed, making it dangerous.
en_grezzo: "Origami paper in which minor deities or spirits dwell. It has jagged edges like a hacksaw, and is designed to cut through the skin and suck up blood. It flies while spinning at high speed, making it dangerous."
it: Un origami in cui abita un dio o uno spirito di rango basso. Ha i bordi seghettati come una lama da taglio, fatti apposta per aprire la pelle e risucchiare il sangue. Vola ruotando ad alta velocità, ed è pericoloso.

jp: 低級の神や精霊を宿らせた折り紙。不思議な動きと魔術で相手を惑わせたり、大量に送りつけることで保管や処分に想像以上のコストをかけさせることが可能。
jp_grezzo: "低級の神や精霊を宿らせた折り紙。不思議な動きと魔術で相手を惑わせたり、大量に送りつけることで保管や処分に想像以上のコストをかけさせることが可能。"
en: Origami paper in which minor deities or spirits dwell. It uses illusionary movements and magic to bewitch opponents, and can be dispatched in large quantities causing them to incur unimaginable costs for storage and disposal.
en_grezzo: "Origami paper in which minor deities or spirits dwell. It uses illusionary movements and magic to bewitch opponents, and can be dispatched in large quantities causing them to incur unimaginable costs for storage and disposal."
it: Un origami in cui abita un dio o uno spirito di rango basso. Confonde l'avversario con movenze inspiegabili e con la magia, e se lo si spedisce a qualcuno in grande quantità gli si fa spendere in custodia e smaltimento molto più di quanto immagini.

jp: 水質汚染で数が減っていたところをキュウリ農家に駆除され、野生の個体は絶滅。寿司屋に捕まって地下で強制労働させられていた個体も、過酷な労働環境には耐えられなかった。皿も奪われて店の食器にされていたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "水質汚染で数が減っていたところをキュウリ農家に駆除され、野生の個体は絶滅。寿司屋に捕まって地下で強制労働させられていた個体も、過酷な労働環境には耐えられなかった。皿も奪われて店の食器にされていたらしい。"
en: Extinct from the wild, when their numbers were declining due to water pollution, they were exterminated by cucumber farmers. Individuals caught by sushi restaurants and forced to work underground could not withstand the harsh working conditions. They were also apparently robbed of their plates and used as shop crockery.
en_grezzo: "Extinct from the wild, when their numbers were declining due to water pollution, they were exterminated by cucumber farmers. Individuals caught by sushi restaurants and forced to work underground could not withstand the harsh working conditions. They were also apparently robbed of their plates and used as shop crockery."
it: Il numero era già calato per l'inquinamento delle acque quando i coltivatori di cetrioli finirono di sterminarli: allo stato brado si sono estinti. Nemmeno gli esemplari catturati dai ristoranti di sushi e costretti ai lavori forzati nei sottoscala hanno retto a quelle condizioni. Pare che togliessero loro anche il piatto dalla testa, per usarlo come stoviglia del locale.

jp: 古代の虎。サーベル状の大きな牙で動きの遅い大型獣を専門に狩っていた。特化しすぎて小型獣を狩れなかったため、主な獲物の絶滅によって一緒に滅びた。勢いよく噛みつきすぎて牙や顎骨が破損することもあったという。
jp_grezzo: "古代の虎。サーベル状の大きな牙で動きの遅い大型獣を専門に狩っていた。特化しすぎて小型獣を狩れなかったため、主な獲物の絶滅によって一緒に滅びた。勢いよく噛みつきすぎて牙や顎骨が破損することもあったという。"
en: Ancient tiger. It specialised in hunting large, slow-moving beasts with its large sabre-shaped tusks. It was too specialised to hunt smaller beasts, so they perished together with it when its main prey became extinct. Sometimes their tusks and jawbones were damaged by biting too vigorously.
en_grezzo: "Ancient tiger. It specialised in hunting large, slow-moving beasts with its large sabre-shaped tusks. It was too specialised to hunt smaller beasts, so they perished together with it when its main prey became extinct. Sometimes their tusks and jawbones were damaged by biting too vigorously."
it: Una tigre antica. Con le grandi zanne a sciabola cacciava di preferenza le bestie grosse e lente. Si era specializzata troppo per prendere prede piccole, e quando la sua preda principale si estinse si estinse con lei. Si dice che a volte, mordendo con troppa foga, si rompesse zanne e mascella.

jp: 鋭い眼光を放つ古代の狼。群れを率いて狩りをしていたが、気候変動によって生息地の獲物が減少した結果、群れを維持できなくなり滅びてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "鋭い眼光を放つ古代の狼。群れを率いて狩りをしていたが、気候変動によって生息地の獲物が減少した結果、群れを維持できなくなり滅びてしまった。"
en: Ancient wolves with sharp eyes. They used to hunt in packs, but as a result of climate change, which reduced prey in their habitat, they were unable to sustain their packs and perished.
en_grezzo: "Ancient wolves with sharp eyes. They used to hunt in packs, but as a result of climate change, which reduced prey in their habitat, they were unable to sustain their packs and perished."
it: Un lupo antico dallo sguardo tagliente. Cacciava guidando il branco, ma il mutare del clima ridusse le prede del suo territorio: non riuscì più a tenere insieme il branco e si estinse.

jp: 白黒模様が特徴的な古代の熊。竹が主食だがそれだけでは栄養がカス過ぎるので、熊らしく魚や動物を襲って食べることもある。人間に生息地を分断され続けたことと、異性の好き嫌いが激しいことから、繁殖が困難になり滅びた。
jp_grezzo: "白黒模様が特徴的な古代の熊。竹が主食だがそれだけでは栄養がカス過ぎるので、熊らしく魚や動物を襲って食べることもある。人間に生息地を分断され続けたことと、異性の好き嫌いが激しいことから、繁殖が困難になり滅びた。"
en: Ancient bear with distinctive black-and-white pattern. Bamboo is its staple food, but as it is too nutritionally depleted, it sometimes attacks and eats fish and animals, as bears do. They perished because their habitat was continually fragmented by humans and because they had a severe predilection for the opposite sex, making it difficult for them to reproduce.
en_grezzo: "Ancient bear with distinctive black-and-white pattern. Bamboo is its staple food, but as it is too nutritionally depleted, it sometimes attacks and eats fish and animals, as bears do. They perished because their habitat was continually fragmented by humans and because they had a severe predilection for the opposite sex, making it difficult for them to reproduce."
it: Un orso antico dalla livrea bianca e nera inconfondibile. Si nutre soprattutto di bambù, ma il bambù nutre troppo poco, e allora ogni tanto fa l'orso e assale pesci e animali per mangiarli. Si è estinto perché gli uomini gli hanno spezzettato il territorio e perché in fatto di partner era troppo schizzinoso: riprodursi gli era diventato difficile.

jp: 百万倍とまではいかないが巨大に進化した古代の獣。親子の愛が生み出す連続攻撃が当時基準ではあまりに強すぎて、環境を徹底的に破壊した。危険視した人間によって大幅に弱められた挙句、一斉に駆除された。
jp_grezzo: "百万倍とまではいかないが巨大に進化した古代の獣。親子の愛が生み出す連続攻撃が当時基準ではあまりに強すぎて、環境を徹底的に破壊した。危険視した人間によって大幅に弱められた挙句、一斉に駆除された。"
en: Ancient beast that evolved into a behemoth, if not a million times larger. The continuous attacks produced by the love between parent and child were too strong by the standards of the time and thoroughly destroyed the environment. It was greatly weakened by humans, who saw it as dangerous, and then exterminated en masse.
en_grezzo: "Ancient beast that evolved into a behemoth, if not a million times larger. The continuous attacks produced by the love between parent and child were too strong by the standards of the time and thoroughly destroyed the environment. It was greatly weakened by humans, who saw it as dangerous, and then exterminated en masse."
it: Una bestia antica evolutasi fino a farsi gigantesca, se non proprio un milione di volte più grande. La raffica di colpi che nasce dall'amore fra madre e figlio era, per gli standard di allora, troppo forte, e devastò l'ambiente da cima a fondo. Gli uomini la giudicarono pericolosa, la indebolirono parecchio e poi la sterminarono tutta in una volta.

jp: 毛を刈った羊とそっくりな古代の獣。生贄として悪魔に捧げられそうになった際に、とっさに悪魔と契約してほぼ不死身となった。破壊と混沌をもたらしたが、この世の理を破りすぎた反動が一気に来て破滅したとされる。
jp_grezzo: "毛を刈った羊とそっくりな古代の獣。生贄として悪魔に捧げられそうになった際に、とっさに悪魔と契約してほぼ不死身となった。破壊と混沌をもたらしたが、この世の理を破りすぎた反動が一気に来て破滅したとされる。"
en: Ancient beast resembling a shorn sheep. When it was about to be sacrificed to the devil, it made a contract with the devil in a moment of desperation and became almost immortal. It is said to have brought destruction and chaos, but was destroyed when the repercussions of breaking too many of the world's laws came at once.
en_grezzo: "Ancient beast resembling a shorn sheep. When it was about to be sacrificed to the devil, it made a contract with the devil in a moment of desperation and became almost immortal. It is said to have brought destruction and chaos, but was destroyed when the repercussions of breaking too many of the world's laws came at once."
it: Una bestia antica identica a una pecora tosata. Quando stava per essere offerta in sacrificio a un demone, nella disperazione strinse lei stessa un patto con il demone e divenne quasi immortale. Portò distruzione e caos, ma si dice che il contraccolpo di tutte le leggi del mondo che aveva infranto le arrivò addosso in un colpo solo, e la annientò.

jp: 心優しい古代の海獣。その性格上、ピンチの仲間を見捨てて逃げることができず、みんなで助けに集まってしまいみんなピンチになる。だから滅びた。
jp_grezzo: "心優しい古代の海獣。その性格上、ピンチの仲間を見捨てて逃げることができず、みんなで助けに集まってしまいみんなピンチになる。だから滅びた。"
en: Ancient sea beast with a kind heart. Because of their nature, they cannot abandon their friends in danger and escape, so they all gather together to help and everyone gets trap. That's why they became extinct.
en_grezzo: "Ancient sea beast with a kind heart. Because of their nature, they cannot abandon their friends in danger and escape, so they all gather together to help and everyone gets trap. That's why they became extinct."
it: Una bestia marina antica dal cuore gentile. Per come è fatta non sa abbandonare un compagno in difficoltà e scappare: si radunano tutte per aiutarlo e finiscono tutte in trappola. Ecco perché si è estinta.

jp: ずっと絶滅を危惧されていた古代の鳥。どうにかこうにか当時の核戦争は生き抜いたものの、死の灰を浴びすぎて弱った体ではその後の乱世を勝ち抜けなかった。
jp_grezzo: "ずっと絶滅を危惧されていた古代の鳥。どうにかこうにか当時の核戦争は生き抜いたものの、死の灰を浴びすぎて弱った体ではその後の乱世を勝ち抜けなかった。"
en: Ancient bird that was endangered for a long time. Somehow they managed to survive the nuclear war of the time, but their bodies, weakened by over exposure to the ashes of death, were unable to survive the turbulent times that followed.
en_grezzo: "Ancient bird that was endangered for a long time. Somehow they managed to survive the nuclear war of the time, but their bodies, weakened by over exposure to the ashes of death, were unable to survive the turbulent times that followed."
it: Un uccello antico che per moltissimo tempo si temette di perdere. Alla guerra nucleare di allora sopravvisse a fatica, ma con un corpo indebolito da troppa cenere di morte non riuscì a superare i tempi sconvolti che vennero dopo.

jp: 大勢で旅行するのが好きな古代の鳥。かつては数十億羽もいたとされるが、美味しいことが人間にバレてしまい狩り尽くされてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "大勢で旅行するのが好きな古代の鳥。かつては数十億羽もいたとされるが、美味しいことが人間にバレてしまい狩り尽くされてしまった。"
en: Ancient birds that like to travel in large numbers. It is believed that there were once billions of them, but they were hunted down when humans discovered how tasty they were.
en_grezzo: "Ancient birds that like to travel in large numbers. It is believed that there were once billions of them, but they were hunted down when humans discovered how tasty they were."
it: Un uccello antico a cui piaceva viaggiare in gran compagnia. Si dice che un tempo fossero miliardi, ma gli uomini scoprirono che erano buoni da mangiare e li cacciarono fino all'ultimo.

jp: 飛ばずに泳ぐ古代の鳥。警戒心が薄く、人懐っこい。この種が本当のペンギンだったのだが、別種の鳥の謀略によって滅ぼされ、ペンギンの名まで奪われてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "飛ばずに泳ぐ古代の鳥。警戒心が薄く、人懐っこい。この種が本当のペンギンだったのだが、別種の鳥の謀略によって滅ぼされ、ペンギンの名まで奪われてしまった。"
en: Ancient bird that swims instead of flying. Unwary and friendly. This species was the original penguin race, but it was destroyed by a plot by another species of bird, depriving them of the name penguin as well.
en_grezzo: "Ancient bird that swims instead of flying. Unwary and friendly. This species was the original penguin race, but it was destroyed by a plot by another species of bird, depriving them of the name penguin as well."
it: Un uccello antico che non vola e nuota. Poco diffidente e affettuoso. Questa specie era il vero pinguino, ma un'altra specie di uccelli la rovinò con un intrigo e le portò via perfino il nome di pinguino.

jp: 飛べない古代の鳥。天敵がいない島でずっと平和ボケしながら暮らしていた。当然の帰結として外敵への対抗手段など持っておらず、島にやってきた悪い人間たちに無抵抗のまま蹂躙されてしまい、絶滅した。
jp_grezzo: "飛べない古代の鳥。天敵がいない島でずっと平和ボケしながら暮らしていた。当然の帰結として外敵への対抗手段など持っておらず、島にやってきた悪い人間たちに無抵抗のまま蹂躙されてしまい、絶滅した。"
en: Ancient flightless bird. They lived peacefully on an island with no natural enemies for a long time. As a natural consequence, it had no means of resisting foreign enemies, and was overrun without resistance by the vicious humans who came to the island, leading to its extinction.
en_grezzo: "Ancient flightless bird. They lived peacefully on an island with no natural enemies for a long time. As a natural consequence, it had no means of resisting foreign enemies, and was overrun without resistance by the vicious humans who came to the island, leading to its extinction."
it: Un uccello antico incapace di volare. Visse a lungo in pace su un'isola senza predatori. Per naturale conseguenza non aveva alcun modo di opporsi a un nemico venuto da fuori, e quando sull'isola arrivarono uomini malvagi si lasciò travolgere senza resistere, fino a sparire.

jp: 長い年月を経て竹が精霊化したもの。精霊化の際になんか３本に増えた。別名タケトリオ。たけのこ時代から暮らしていた里を旅立ち、人間の掘った穴を探して住み着く。普段は先端に毒や汚物を塗っていたりするが、１月に門松のバイトをする時は奇麗にしている。
jp_grezzo: "長い年月を経て竹が精霊化したもの。精霊化の際になんか３本に増えた。別名タケトリオ。たけのこ時代から暮らしていた里を旅立ち、人間の掘った穴を探して住み着く。普段は先端に毒や汚物を塗っていたりするが、１月に門松のバイトをする時は奇麗にしている。"
en: Bamboo that has been spiritualized over a long period of time. At the time of spiritualization, it has somehow increased to a trio, known as the Bamboo Trio. They leave the village where they have lived since the age of bamboo, and find a hole dug by humans to live in. They usually have poison or filth smeared on the tips, however they are clean and tidy when they work part-time on the kadomatsu in January.
en_grezzo: "Bamboo that has been spiritualized over a long period of time. At the time of spiritualization, it has somehow increased to a trio, known as the Bamboo Trio. They leave the village where they have lived since the age of bamboo, and find a hole dug by humans to live in. They usually have poison or filth smeared on the tips, however they are clean and tidy when they work part-time on the kadomatsu in January."
it: Un bambù che con gli anni si è fatto spirito. Nel farsi spirito, chissà come, si è moltiplicato per tre: lo chiamano anche il Trio di Bambù. Lascia il villaggio in cui viveva fin da germoglio e cerca una buca scavata dagli uomini per andarci ad abitare. Di solito tiene la punta spalmata di veleno o di sozzura, ma a gennaio, quando fa la stagione come addobbo di capodanno, si presenta pulito.

jp: かわいそうな私アピールのためだけに地雷原に住んでいるメンヘラ。すぐ感情などを爆発させるし、一緒に死のうとしてくるので厄介。対戦車といっても人がぞんざいに扱って大丈夫というわけではない。
jp_grezzo: "かわいそうな私アピールのためだけに地雷原に住んでいるメンヘラ。すぐ感情などを爆発させるし、一緒に死のうとしてくるので厄介。対戦車といっても人がぞんざいに扱って大丈夫というわけではない。"
en: Mentally ill girl who lives in a minefield just for the appeal of \"poor me\". They are troublesome because they can easily let their emotions go out and try to die together with you. Even though it is an anti-tank, it does not mean that people can treat it with care.
en_grezzo: "Mentally ill girl who lives in a minefield just for the appeal of \"poor me\". They are troublesome because they can easily let their emotions go out and try to die together with you. Even though it is an anti-tank, it does not mean that people can treat it with care."
it: Una ragazza dall'umore instabile che vive in un campo minato solo per far vedere quanto sia da compatire. Fa esplodere le emozioni per un nulla e cerca di morire insieme a chi le sta accanto: è una bella grana. Anticarro non vuol dire che una persona possa trattarla con leggerezza.

jp: かわいそうな私アピールのためだけに地雷原に住んでいるメンヘラ。すぐ感情などを爆発させるし、一緒に死のうとしてくるので厄介。普段は大人しいが、油断した頃にいきなり飛びついて加害してくるので危険。
jp_grezzo: "かわいそうな私アピールのためだけに地雷原に住んでいるメンヘラ。すぐ感情などを爆発させるし、一緒に死のうとしてくるので厄介。普段は大人しいが、油断した頃にいきなり飛びついて加害してくるので危険。"
en: Mentally ill girl who lives in a minefield just for the appeal of \"poor me\". They are troublesome because they can easily let their emotions go out and try to die together with you. They are usually quiet, but when they are caught off guard, they will suddenly jump on you and harm you, making them dangerous.
en_grezzo: "Mentally ill girl who lives in a minefield just for the appeal of \"poor me\". They are troublesome because they can easily let their emotions go out and try to die together with you. They are usually quiet, but when they are caught off guard, they will suddenly jump on you and harm you, making them dangerous."
it: Una ragazza dall'umore instabile che vive in un campo minato solo per far vedere quanto sia da compatire. Fa esplodere le emozioni per un nulla e cerca di morire insieme a chi le sta accanto: è una bella grana. Di solito se ne sta buona, ma appena l'altro abbassa la guardia salta su all'improvviso e colpisce: pericolosa.

jp: かわいそうな私アピールのためだけに地雷原に住んでいるメンヘラ。すぐ感情などを爆発させるし、一緒に死のうとしてくるので厄介。見えている地雷なのだが、扇状に散弾をぶちかましてくるので回避は困難。
jp_grezzo: "かわいそうな私アピールのためだけに地雷原に住んでいるメンヘラ。すぐ感情などを爆発させるし、一緒に死のうとしてくるので厄介。見えている地雷なのだが、扇状に散弾をぶちかましてくるので回避は困難。"
en: Mentally ill girl who lives in a minefield just for the appeal of \"poor me\". They are troublesome because they can easily let their emotions go out and try to die together with you. They use visible land mines normally, but it is difficult to avoid them because they spray bullets at you in a fan-like pattern.
en_grezzo: "Mentally ill girl who lives in a minefield just for the appeal of \"poor me\". They are troublesome because they can easily let their emotions go out and try to die together with you. They use visible land mines normally, but it is difficult to avoid them because they spray bullets at you in a fan-like pattern."
it: Una ragazza dall'umore instabile che vive in un campo minato solo per far vedere quanto sia da compatire. Fa esplodere le emozioni per un nulla e cerca di morire insieme a chi le sta accanto: è una bella grana. È una mina che si vede, ma spara una rosa di pallettoni a ventaglio, e schivarla è difficile.
